name: The world remembers every footstep
text: The world remembers every footstep, even when the sand forgets.
sources: the owner's draft of nomadic-migration sayings for the cutscenes, 2026-10-01
notes: Carried by the dune scavengers since 2 October 2026: the owner asked for the fictional sayings to belong to the lore's various peoples, not all to the Vedda.
